subject.title: feat(cron): per-job dynamic cadence (pacing + clamped next_check)

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor per-job agent-driven pacing as a standalone stage-one cron capability now, rather than wait for the broader unified-automation design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/110950?
rationale: This introduces a stored job field, CLI controls, gateway schema fields, and a model-facing tool action; the linked roadmap item is explicitly awaiting maintainer product direction.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded stage one
options.body: Approve the core pacing direction after the scheduling-invariant defects and live behavior proof are resolved.

options.title: Defer to cron unification
options.body: Pause this PR until the broader heartbeat and automation ownership plan is accepted and its public contract is narrowed.
